title: Classification.
officialText:
Buildings and spaces shall be classified in the institutional occupancy group when persons suffering from physical limitations because of health or age are harbored therein for care or treatment; when persons are detained therein for penal or correctional purposes; or when the liberty of the incarcerated individuals is restricted. The institutional occupancy group consists of sub groups H-1 and H-2.

(Am. 2021 N.Y. Laws Ch. 322, 8/2/2021, eff. 8/2/2021)
